mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as higher inflation signals potential monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.2% increase in the past month) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when UNRATE > 0.2pp increase (mo/mo) and INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) is associated with more pronounced negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days, as the market interprets the rate hike as a necessary response to inflation, leading to reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return for the high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL>200) when FEDFUNDS>5.0% is not significantly lower than for the low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL<=200) when FEDFUNDS>5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1700 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when HOUST < 1700.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as the market reacts quickly to monetary policy signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the days when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 360,000 million dollars signals a weakening consumer sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when RSAFS < 360000.
